sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: There's never been any doubt that this year's presidential race would be won or lost in a handful of purple swing states where neither party has a clear advantage.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，今年的总统大选胜负将取决于少数几个摇摆州，两党在这些州都没有绝对优势。

sentences.en: That, however, is not the case for Congress.
sentences.zh: 然而，国会的情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Nick Fandos on why control of the House is likely to hinge on what happens in two deeply blue states where Democrats run the show.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事尼克·凡多斯（Nick Fandos）将探讨为何众议院的控制权很可能取决于两个深蓝州的情况，而这两个州目前由民主党掌控。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月15日，星期二。

sentences.en: Nick, thank you for making time for us on a holiday, no less.
sentences.zh: 尼克，感谢你在假期里抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Michael, I am very pleased to be here.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: So I feel like if you're keeping count,
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果你在统计的话，

sentences.en: I dare say we have made 100 episodes, that's an exaggeration, but a lot of episodes about the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 我敢说我们已经制作了100期关于总统大选的节目——这有点夸张，但确实做了很多。

sentences.en: But we have spent comparatively little time talking about who's going to control Congress.
sentences.zh: 但相比之下，我们花在讨论谁将控制国会上的时间却很少。

sentences.en: And today, with you, we are going to rectify that.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将和你一起纠正这一点。

sentences.en: And in particular, we're going to talk about control of the House of Representatives, the lower chamber.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我们要讨论众议院，即下议院的控制权。

sentences.en: So set the stage for us and walk us through the stakes of this year's races for the House.
sentences.zh: 那么，请为我们铺垫一下，带我们了解一下今年众议院选举的利害关系。

sentences.en: Yeah, let me make a case for why the House of Representatives is uniquely important in this election.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我阐述一下为什么众议院在这次选举中具有独特的意义。

sentences.en: So obviously, as we all know, the race for the White House is incredibly close.
sentences.zh: 显然，众所周知，白宫之争极其胶着。

sentences.en: But the race for the Senate is really tipping towards Republicans right now.
sentences.zh: 但参议院的选情目前确实正向共和党倾斜。

sentences.en: Democrats have a shot, but it's an outside shot to keep control of the Senate.
sentences.zh: 民主党还有机会，但保住参议院控制权的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: So the House of Representatives is really kind of the second most important question.
sentences.zh: 所以众议院实际上是第二重要的议题。

sentences.en: Because if Donald Trump wins the White House and Republicans have the Senate, the House being Republican would be a trifecta.
sentences.zh: 因为如果唐纳德·特朗普赢得了白宫，而共和党又控制了参议院，那么共和党控制众议院将形成“三连胜”。

sentences.en: It would unlock his ability to implement most of his policy agenda.
sentences.zh: 这将使他能够实施其大部分政策议程。

sentences.en: It would protect him from investigation or impeachment and really kind of lay the groundwork for two years of conservative Republican policymaking.
sentences.zh: 这将保护他免受调查或弹劾，并为未来两年的保守派共和党政策制定奠定基础。

sentences.en: On the other hand, if Kamala Harris wins the White House and doesn't have control of the Senate, the House is really going to be her only leverage point on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果卡玛拉·哈里斯赢得了白宫，但没有控制参议院，众议院将成为她在国会山唯一的筹码。

sentences.en: It's going to be the kind of Democratic beachhead to help her try and get anything accomplished.
sentences.zh: 这将成为民主党的滩头阵地，帮助她尝试完成任何目标。

sentences.en: But it is so close this year that there's a feasible possibility that actually Trump could win the White House and Democrats could keep control of the House,
sentences.zh: 但今年的选情如此接近，以至于有一种可能：特朗普赢得白宫，而民主党保住众议院的控制权，

sentences.en: which would be a very powerful, potent check on a potential Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 这将成为对潜在特朗普总统任期的一种强有力的制衡。

sentences.en: Remember, they impeached him twice before when he was in office.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，在他任职期间，他们曾两次弹劾他。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In other words, no matter what happens, no matter who wins the White House, the House becomes the linchpin for either unified government or divided government.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，无论发生什么，无论谁入主白宫，众议院都将成为统一政府或分裂政府的关键。

sentences.en: Very consequential either way.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种结果，影响都非常深远。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And even before that happens, the House is going to play a very important role in the kind of end stages of this presidential election.
sentences.zh: 而且在这一切发生之前，众议院将在本次总统大选的最后阶段发挥非常重要的作用。

sentences.en: It is, as we all learned in 2021, the body that has to certify, at the end, the results of the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在2021年所了解到的，众议院是最终必须认证总统选举结果的机构。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And last time,
sentences.zh: 而上一次，

sentences.en: Donald Trump and his allies in the House were able to make a remarkable run at trying to disrupt that process, despite the fact that Democrats were in control of the House.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普及其在众议院的盟友曾试图破坏这一进程，尽管当时民主党控制着众议院。

sentences.en: So, one can imagine a scenario where this time around, if Republicans narrowly hold on to it, and the presidential election ends up in a near tie or another contested outcome,
sentences.zh: 所以，人们可以想象这样一种情况：如果这一次共和党勉强保住众议院，而总统大选结果接近平局或出现争议，

sentences.en: who is in control on Capitol Hill could be unbelievably important.
sentences.zh: 谁控制国会山将变得极其重要。

sentences.en: I just want to make sure I understand that because I think the timing can get confusing for people.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确保我理解了这一点，因为我认为时间节点对人们来说可能会让人困惑。

sentences.en: We think of Congress being sworn in around the time of the presidential inauguration.
sentences.zh: 我们认为国会是在总统就职典礼前后宣誓就职的。

sentences.en: It actually happens before.
sentences.zh: 实际上是在那之前。

sentences.en: So, a new Congress will be required to certify the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 因此，新一届国会将需要认证选举结果。

sentences.en: You're saying if Republicans win control of the House of Representatives and Kamala Harris were to win the presidential race, then suddenly you're looking at
sentences.zh: 你是说如果共和党赢得了众议院控制权，而卡玛拉·哈里斯赢得了总统大选，那么你面对的将是

sentences.en: a Republican-controlled House that may try to block her certification as president, which would once again plunge this country into a very complicated
sentences.zh: 一个由共和党控制的众议院，他们可能会试图阻止她作为总统的认证，这将再次把这个国家推向一个非常复杂

sentences.en: and potentially very dark place.
sentences.zh: 且可能非常黑暗的境地。

sentences.en: I think that that's a good summary and certainly a question and a scenario that's on a lot of people's minds right now.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个很好的总结，这无疑是目前许多人心中都在思考的问题和情景。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, what, Nick, is the current understanding of both parties' chances of winning control of the House right now?
sentences.zh: 那么，尼克，目前两党赢得众议院控制权的机会是如何评估的？

sentences.en: You explained when it comes to the Senate that the odds are very much that Republicans will flip it, win control.
sentences.zh: 你解释过参议院的情况，共和党很有可能翻盘并赢得控制权。

sentences.en: Now walk us through the odds of the House.
sentences.zh: 现在请带我们了解一下众议院的胜算。

sentences.en: Yeah, the House is a true toss-up.
sentences.zh: 是的，众议院的选情完全是五五开。

sentences.en: It is on a knife's edge.
sentences.zh: 处于千钧一发之际。

sentences.en: Republicans right now effectively have a four-seat majority, basically the narrowest majority in a century, and they're out there defending it, and there's a very limited number
sentences.zh: 共和党目前实际上拥有四个席位的多数优势，这基本上是百年来最微弱的多数优势，他们正在努力捍卫它，而且由于两党的选区划分，

sentences.en: of competitive seats across the country because of gerrymandering in both parties, which have shrunk the map.
sentences.zh: 全国范围内的竞争性席位非常有限，这缩小了竞争版图。

sentences.en: A few dozen seats that could tip either way, and an even smaller number of that that may affect the final outcome.
sentences.zh: 只有几十个席位可能倒向任何一方，其中只有极少数会影响最终结果。

sentences.en: But the really interesting feature of the race for the House this year is that the true battlegrounds don't match up with the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 但今年众议院选举的一个非常有趣的特点是，真正的战场与总统大选并不重合。

sentences.en: We're not talking about Wisconsin or Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不是威斯康星州或宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: There are some races there.
sentences.zh: 那里确实有一些竞选。

sentences.en: But the biggest clusters are actually in two large coastal blue states,
sentences.zh: 但最大的集群实际上是在两个大型沿海蓝州，

sentences.en: New York and California.
sentences.zh: 纽约州和加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: And why would that be?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, let me just give a sense of numbers first, which I think will help illustrate this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我先给出一个数字概念，我认为这有助于说明这一点。

sentences.en: There are 17 seats that Republicans hold right now that President Biden won four years ago.
sentences.zh: 共和党目前持有的席位中，有17个是拜登总统四年前赢下的。

sentences.en: Of those, 10 of them are in New York and California.
sentences.zh: 其中10个位于纽约州和加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: And five or six of them,
sentences.zh: 而且其中五六个，

sentences.en: Biden actually won by double digits.
sentences.zh: 拜登实际上是以两位数的优势获胜的。

sentences.en: So to put it in a different way,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: Republicans in 2020 and 2022 were able to win a set of districts to build their majority that, you know, by registration or makeup, tend to tilt Democratic
sentences.zh: 共和党在2020年和2022年能够赢得一系列选区来建立多数优势，这些选区按登记或构成来看，往往倾向于民主党

sentences.en: or vote for Democrats for president.
sentences.zh: 或在总统选举中投票给民主党。

sentences.en: And so that means that Democrats' clearest path to winning back the majority runs through those two states.
sentences.zh: 这意味着民主党夺回多数席位的最清晰路径就在这两个州。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What do we need to remember about those races two years ago that helps explain this dynamic and how we got here in these two deep blue states?
sentences.zh: 关于两年前的那些选举，我们需要记住什么，才能帮助解释这种动态，以及我们是如何在这两个深蓝州走到这一步的？

sentences.en: So just to rewind the clock a little bit, remember, you know,
sentences.zh: 让我们把时间倒回一点，记住，

sentences.en: 2022 was Biden's first midterm.
sentences.zh: 2022年是拜登的第一次中期选举。

sentences.en: Typically the party out of power.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，在野党。

sentences.en: Republicans are expected to make a bunch of gains across the country in the House.
sentences.zh: 共和党预计会在全国范围内的众议院选举中获得大量收益。

sentences.en: Republicans were expecting to pick up a pretty big majority.
sentences.zh: 共和党曾预计会获得相当大的多数席位。

sentences.en: And by and large, they had an underwhelming night in most of the country, except for New York and California.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，除了纽约州和加利福尼亚州，他们在全国大部分地区的表现都不尽如人意。

sentences.en: And there are different reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 这有不同的原因。

sentences.en: New York and California, as anyone who has visited there or lives there knows, are very expensive places.
sentences.zh: 正如任何去过或住过那里的人所知，纽约和加州的生活成本非常高。

sentences.en: And so they're extra sensitive to inflation and food and housing and basically put voters into a very sour mood.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们对通货膨胀、食品和住房问题格外敏感，这基本上让选民的情绪非常糟糕。

sentences.en: At the same time, the pandemic brought this disruption to life all across the board and a spike in crime in some places.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，疫情给各行各业的生活带来了混乱，一些地方的犯罪率激增。

sentences.en: And it was really intensely felt, for instance, in New York, where a daily drumbeat of crimes on the subway or violent crimes on the street became kind of the dominant issue
sentences.zh: 这种感受非常强烈，例如在纽约，地铁上的日常犯罪或街头的暴力犯罪成为了中期选举中

sentences.en: of the midterm campaigns.
sentences.zh: 主导性的议题。

sentences.en: And Republicans were able to really effectively message on this issue.
sentences.zh: 共和党能够非常有效地利用这一议题进行宣传。

sentences.en: And I think that the thing that unifies these states is that they're both states where Democrats have total control of government, where voters are looking at these problems,
sentences.zh: 我认为这些州的共同点在于，它们都是民主党完全控制政府的州，选民们看着这些问题，

sentences.en: which many places are facing across the country, but they have one party, basically, that's in charge that they can blame.
sentences.zh: 虽然全国许多地方都面临同样的问题，但他们只有一个执政党可以责怪。

sentences.en: Democrats control mayor's offices, the governor's mansions, and the White House.
sentences.zh: 民主党控制着市长办公室、州长官邸和白宫。

sentences.en: So, you know, why wouldn't you, if you're fed up about these issues and you think that government is not doing enough to help, well, you know, you go against the guys in power
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对这些问题感到厌倦，认为政府做得不够，那么，你当然会反对当权者，

sentences.en: and that meant going with Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这意味着支持共和党。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in that sense,
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，

sentences.en: Republicans weaponized
sentences.zh: 共和党将

sentences.en: New York and California's blueness and used it against them very effectively through the issue, especially, of crime.
sentences.zh: 纽约和加州的“蓝色”属性武器化，并特别通过犯罪问题非常有效地对付他们。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。
